create_messages: create messages by posting to the /v1/messages endpoint with an AnthropicMessagesRequest
count_tokens: count tokens by posting to the /v1/messages/count_tokens endpoint with an AnthropicCountTokensRequest
attach_router: attach the anthropic API router to a FastAPI application instance
translate_error_response: translate an OpenAI ErrorResponse into an Anthropic-compatible JSON error response
create_streaming_messages: create streaming messages via SSE response from the /v1/messages endpoint
